en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a small roadside stone shrine with a tiled gabled roof topped by a cross. Inside the arched niche stands a statue of the Virgin Mary, likely Our Lady of Lourdes or a similar Marian depiction. The shrine is built from rough-hewn dark stones with lighter stones accenting the arch, set on a stepped stone base along a dirt path, with trees and foliage in the background. The image has scalloped postcard-style edges and two punch holes at the top.
